name: Phenethylamine (compound)
summary: Phenethylamine (compound) is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Phenethylamine (PEA) is an organic compound, natural monoamine alkaloid, and trace amine, which acts as a central nervous system stimulant in humans. In the brain, phenethylamine regulates monoamine neurotransmission by binding to trace amine-associated receptor 1 (TAAR1) and inhibiting vesicular monoamine transporter 2 (VMAT2) in monoamine neurons.
pharmacology.kind: Norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent; Trace amine-associated receptor 1 (TAAR1) agonist; Stimulant

body.says: Primarily: MAO-B; Other enzymes: MAO-A, SSAOs (AOC2 & AOC3), PNMT, AANAT, FMO3, and others

uses.text: Phenethylamine is sold as a dietary supplement for purported mood- and weight loss-related therapeutic benefits; however, in orally ingested phenethylamine, a significant amount is metabolized in the small intestine by monoamine oxidase B (MAO-B) and then aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH), which converts it to phenylacetic acid.
